So the 17th Amendment obviously was passed to go from state legislatures picking the two senators to a popular direct election of senators. So Medicaid programs are hard to run well. We should want governors to want to compete at better, higher quality, lower cost Medicaid programs. And by and large, we don't have a lot of that kind of competition because there's so much coercive, not real federalism. I would like to see state legislatures more powerful again. And I think one of the things you could get if we repealed the 17th Amendment is you can get to a world where legislatures at the state level would be screaming to Washington, D.C.
